title: Chrome 솔로 #047 · hourglass bombshell · 크롬 블랙 · 손 허리 · 대교 보행로 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sculpted updo auburn hair — full body mirror-polished black liquid chrome fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid liquid chrome body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a seamless liquid-metal chrome shell with a perfect mirror finish, reflecting the surroundings in sharp warped images that bend over every curve, hard bright white highlights and deep dark reflections side by side, smooth and seamless with no joints, nothing lying flat. Dense mirror surface — BLAZING flawless mirror jet-black chrome across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep blue and violet reflections warping over every curve, with sharp white highlights streaking along her sides, mirror-polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same black chrome, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same black chrome with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: a wide pedestrian walkway on a large suspension bridge with a waist-high railing, standard lamp posts and the city skyline in daylight, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
